reason: I know the Yu Chun name and my family wants the real chik naengmyeon, so for one dinner on this trip I will take them, order kalbi to share and noodles for everyone. It is a treat night, not a regular place for me.
objection: With my family we are five or more, so the 20% gratuity on top of $38.95 kalbi and $19 noodles makes the bill heavy, and I know I can get naengmyeon cheaper on Keeaumoku St.
would_change_my_mind: If a quick look showed the bill for my group would be over about $60 a person after the gratuity, I would take them to a cheaper place on Keeaumoku instead.
